messages.author: 2ef256a129b97763
messages.subject: Again on RRO & Sublime Text
parts:
Apologies to keep hammering on the integration between RRO and Sublime Text. On the other hand I know it is dear to many users.

As I had to install R on a "new" yosemite OS X machine, I thought to try to "fix" the issue with SublimeREPL R once for all.

Basically SublimeREPL R allows you to split the Sublime screen into two parts, running the console on one half of the screen.

Normally (with R CRAN) the setting to launch R are:  "--interactive", "--no-readline" .  

RRO does not work with the above settings: basically R lays torpidly on the half of the screen and no cursor is displayed.  Either entering data in this console (or sending it from the first half of the screen) does not produce any visible result.

Changing the settings to "--vanilla" lead RRO to act in batch mode.  With this setting all is OK: I see the cursor, I can use the console as a normal REPL. The issue is that ANY error terminates the session (and this is correct for R working in batch mode).    As I do MANY errors this is very annoying and defeating the purpose.

My hypothesis is that RRO either ignores or misbehaves when the directives  "--interactive", "--no-readline" are set (not relative to batch mode).

Would it be possible to "test" these functions to make sure that all is OK with RRO?

Many thanks
